## Description

Pipes real-time financial news websockets and earnings transcripts through a pre-trained FinBERT model to calculate normalized sentiment scores ($S_{news}, S_{earnings}$) for trade signal generation.

## Where it may fit

Scheduled earnings releases, FDA approval announcements, unexpected corporate action news, short-seller report releases.

## Vehicles

Event-driven hedge funds, short-term equity trading desks, API-automated retail strategies.

## Required data

Live news feed (e.g. Alpaca News WebSocket, RavenPack), earnings transcripts, historical price impact per sentiment tier.

## Caveats

Requires local GPU or cloud inference API for low-latency scoring; requires noise filtering for repetitive or syndicated news feeds.
